structured.answer: From what I read, it sounds worth having, because the employer puts in money on top of my salary. I can take it out without tax after 6 years, or after 3 years if it's for studies. Before I sign anything, I'll ask you or the bank about the 2% fee and which "מסלול" to pick.

stuck.why: Too many coloured bars and numbers. The red '−13,974 ₪' with the pink stripes scared me, and I couldn't tell if it was a loss or just tax. The brown and yellow colours were too close to tell apart.

stuck.where: Screen 2, the buttons under 'במה אפשר להשקיע בתוכו'
stuck.why: 'S&P 500 מדד' and 'מסלול כללי' mean nothing to me. I didn't know which one was the safe one.

stuck.where: Screen 1, the row '123 מקור 123 מחושב 123 הזנתה'
stuck.why: I didn't understand what the coloured numbers were for, so I left them.

findings.what: A red minus number with pink stripes in the middle of a chart scared me off without saying clearly in words what it is.
Busy chart with close colours (brown/yellow/green) and a slider
English letters and words I don't know right on the second screen
The fee says only 'עד 2%', so I can't tell if that's a lot or what I'd actually pay

I don't know the site name 'מקור'. It doesn't say who's behind it, so I'm not sure I can trust it.
